[SWS_PER_00440]
d
When
ara::per::FileStorage::GetFileInfo
is called for
an existing but currently not opened
file
,
Persistency
shall gather the required
information from any existing instance of the
file
(without checking the consistency/-
validity of this
file
) into a
ara::per::FileInfo
struct and return it to the
appli-
cation
.
c
